schema.columns: 65 columns, no header row: 64 pixel values (0-16, row-major 8x8 image) followed by a label column (0-9)

notes: No train/test split in the source file - perceptron/digits_data.py's own split_train_test does the split at load time, per the design proposal's intent to keep the source file in the canonical format the consuming project already reads.
